name: Minamiise (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamiise town emblem in navy, blue and light blue: a swirl of navy, blue and light blue curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiise, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.
